title: 第28章 叔侄续第27章 真落阳行动开幕
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: （感谢星之浊大佬赠送的大神认证！！！）
“什么他妈狗屁的落阳行动？！”
罗德里克将腰间的王剑一把拍在书案上，整个人往椅背上一靠，脸色一阵青一阵红，胸口起伏不止。
情况他大概已经从那些围堵在外头的记者嘴里弄清楚了。
简而言之，就是今日白天龙都大战的时候，罗德里克与教会的注意力悉数被转移到索兰尼亚。于是双方打得昏天黑地的时候，弗雷德里克就派人武装占领了罗兰特。
这已经不是第一次了。
两年前《屠龙计划》刚刚结束的那会儿，弗雷德里克就做过一次类似的事，还整了个什么东摩恩帝国来恶心自己。
但好歹，当时的弗雷德里克至少是用渗透市政府、收买港务系统这些相对柔和的手段，悄悄掌握了海都。
后来，弗雷德里克为了专心对付真理之神，便将海都的控制权奉还给了罗德里克。
罗德里克也就宽宏大量地没再去追究。
可这一次……
“这个王八蛋不仅杀光了我在海都的驻军，还袭击了整条使馆街！奥菲斯帝国银行的cro还在沙滩度假，被他连躺椅带人直接扣了！”
罗德里克指节都在书案上敲得发白，气得嘴皮子都在颤抖。
要知道，自从灯塔和会之后，原本属于摩恩的“蔚蓝海都”罗兰特，名义上就已经成了自由都市。
奥菲斯、洛斯林德、无尽海诸国，乃至目前处于无政府状态的比蒙，都在这里设有自己的办事处。
尤其是对于无尽海那些城邦和群岛国家而言，罗兰特不只是一座港口，更是他们的离岸金库。
弗雷德里克这一手，等同于直接捅了整个奇兰所有大小势力一刀！
或者用更加直白的说法：
从这一刻起，奥菲斯帝国已经有了充分且完全的理由，直接向罗兰特发起军事行动，一举完成三年前他们在灯塔和会上未竟的事业。
然而，即便是这一切的一切，比起后面的这件事而言，也只能算是小巫见大巫。
“国王陛下！请问巴巴罗萨自称弗雷德里克·路德维希一事，是否属实？”
“弗雷德里克殿下三年前被曝与魔族勾结，并被认定为卡美洛事件的始作俑者。请问他这三年的假死潜逃，是否曾得到摩恩王室的包庇或授意？”
“国王陛下，请您出面回应！”
时近晚间十点。
大概是由于昂德索雷斯没有夜晚的缘故，外头记者的兴奋不仅没有削减，反而愈发高涨。
罗德里克有些脱力地闭上眼睛，长长叹出一口气。
这就是他为什么点名禁止弗雷德里克掺和进《落阳行动》的原因。
同样都是不在乎摩恩的万家灯火，齐格飞至少会尊重罗德里克和克琳希德的想法，也会顾忌雷光、罗兰、卡塔丽娜这些真正在乎摩恩的人。
但弗雷德里克不会。
只要能干掉太阳神教，这个男人会无所不用其极。
弗雷德里克的目的，任谁都能看得分明。
他这是要拉着整个奇兰大陆攻伐摩恩王国，或者说，扳倒藏在摩恩幕后的太阳神国！
目前，罗德里克对外的态度，是一口咬死自己根本不认识什么巴巴罗萨，至于对方自称是已故王兄弗雷德里克·路德维希，更是彻头彻尾的无稽之谈。
王都方面将立刻组织军队清剿这伙盘踞海都的海盗武装，解救遭到挟持的国家代表，还自由都市一个晴朗安宁的明天云云。
拉斐尔手捧圣典站在一旁，听着窗外不断涌进来的记者呼喊，脸色也颇为难看。
原本请这些奥菲斯记者前来，是指望他们报道摩恩内战结束、王女获救、南境归心的消息。
不曾想偷鸡不成蚀把米，全成了笑话。
“沙利叶去哪了？”
国王这时疲惫地开口询问：

(Thanks to Mr. Xingzhizhuo for the great certification!!!)
"What the fuck is Operation Sunset?!"
Roderick slapped the Wang Sword at his waist on the desk and leaned back in his chair. His face turned green and red, and his chest kept rising and falling.
He probably figured out the situation from the reporters gathered outside.
In short, during the daytime battle in Longdu, the attention of Roderick and the church was entirely diverted to Solamnia. So when the two sides were fighting fiercely, Frederick sent armed men to occupy Roland.
This is not the first time.
Two years ago, just after the "Dragon Slaying Plan" ended, Frederick did something similar once, and even built some kind of East Morn Empire to disgust himself.
But at least, at that time, Frederick at least used relatively gentle methods such as infiltrating the city government and buying the port system to quietly control Haidu.
Later, in order to concentrate on dealing with the God of Truth, Frederick returned control of Haidu to Roderick.
Roderick magnanimously did not pursue it any further.
But this time...
"This bastard not only killed all my garrison in Haidu, but also attacked the entire Embassy Street! The Cro of the Orpheus Imperial Bank was still on vacation at the beach, and he took the recliner and his men straight away!"
Roderick's knuckles turned white as he banged them on the desk, and his lips were trembling with anger.
You know, since the Lighthouse Peace Conference, Roland, the "Blue Sea City" that originally belonged to Moen, has become a free city in name.
Orpheus, Lothlinde, the countries of the Endless Sea, and even Beamon, which is currently in an anarchic state, all have their own offices here.
Especially for the city-states and archipelago countries in the Endless Sea, Roland is not only a port, but also their offshore treasury.
Frederick's move was equivalent to directly stabbing all the big and small forces in Chilan!
Or to put it more bluntly:
From this moment on, the Orpheus Empire had sufficient and complete reasons to directly launch military operations against Roland, completing in one fell swoop what they had not finished at the Lighthouse Peace Conference three years ago.
However, even all of this is nothing compared to what happened next.
"Your Majesty the King! Is it true that Barbarossa calls himself Frederick Ludwig?"
"His Royal Highness Frederick was exposed to collude with the demons three years ago and was identified as the instigator of the Camelot incident. Did he receive the protection or instruction of the Morn royal family in his fake death and absconding in the past three years?"
"Your Majesty the King, please come forward and respond!"
It was nearly ten o'clock in the evening.
Probably because there were no nights in Andersaures, the excitement of the reporters outside did not diminish, but intensified.
Roderick closed his eyes with some exhaustion and let out a long sigh.
That's why he banned Frederick by name from being involved in Operation Sunset.
They are all Wanjia Denghuang who don't care about Morn. Siegfried will at least respect the ideas of Roderick and Clinehid, and will also care about people like Lei Guang, Roland, and Katarina who really care about Morn.
But not Frederick.
As long as he can kill the Sun God Cult, this man will do anything.
Everyone can clearly see Frederick's purpose.
He wants to lead the entire Qilan Continent to attack the Kingdom of Moen, or in other words, overthrow the Kingdom of the Sun God hidden behind the scenes of Moen!
At present, Roderick's external attitude is to insist that he does not know Barbarossa at all. As for the other party's claim to be the late brother Frederick Ludwig, it is complete nonsense.
The royal capital will immediately organize an army to clear out this group of pirate armed forces entrenched in the sea capital, rescue the kidnapped national representatives, and restore a clear and peaceful tomorrow to the free city.
Raphael stood aside holding the holy scripture in his hand, listening to the reporters shouting outside the window, his face was quite ugly.
These Orpheus reporters were originally invited to report the news of the end of the Morn Civil War, the rescue of the princess, and the return of the Southern Territory.
I never thought that stealing the chicken would end up losing the rice, and everything turned into a joke.
"Where did Sariel go?"
The king asked tiredly:
